column1: # Jakarta EE / Java EE fact counters for Java sources: the counters of java-facts, then the
# component and wiring annotations of EJB, JPA, CDI, JAX-RS, JAX-WS, Servlet, JTA and security, with
# or without their package (javax. and jakarta.; Spring's @Autowired and @Transactional too). For a
# rule that routes Java files using these APIs (a contentMatches on their imports, or on an
# annotation written with its package) next to the plain Java rule. java-facts' [ignore] line blanks
# comments and strings first, and an annotation counts at the start of a line or after other
# annotations on it, so an "@Stateless" in Javadoc prose or a commented-out one does not count. JvmFactPatternsTest pins every case;
# ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest measures that every pattern reads linearly.
